summary: Empty-struct amplification-shader payload (struct S{}; DispatchMesh(1,1,1,s)) still fails DXIL validation on main (89e2f98e2) exactly as reported: 'payload size 4 is greater than declared size of 0 bytes'. Always-repro'd since as_6_6 shipped (v1.6.2104) through v1.9.2607 and on main; v1.4.1907/v1.5.2010 predate as_6_6. Root cause identified by source read: ValidateAsIntrinsics in DxilValidation.cpp measures the payload POINTER's DataLayout alloc size (constant 4 on DXIL's 32-bit-pointer datalayout) instead of the pointee struct's size, so the check only fires when the real struct size is below 4 bytes -- i.e. only for an empty struct. Confirmed with two controls: a 4-byte payload compiles clean, and -Vd on the empty payload also compiles clean while emitting a declared size of 0 in DXIL metadata, isolating the defect to this one validator comparison. Same defect independently identified in #5269 (filed three months earlier) with a matching source-level finding.
title: DispatchMesh fails when given an emtpy struct
